verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the ingredients but not the workflow. The Agent SDK accepts image and document attachments alongside prompts, PDFs appear as Documents in the sidebar, and the agent can autonomously build code across editor, terminal and browser. Nothing documents turning a sketch, image or PDF design into a working app. Missing for 10: an explicit documented design-to-app workflow, sketch/image input evidenced in the IDE/desktop app rather than only the SDK, and hands-on or independent confirmation that a working app results.
